fusions.name: First Touch
fusions.desc: A kick that deals 4 damage, rising by 5% for every 10% of health the target still has (up to 30%), and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Silent Pounce
fusions.desc: Springs up to 6 tiles onto the target, dealing 15 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Padded Stride
fusions.desc: Slips 2 tiles forward, then for 6 seconds you move 25% faster and your dodge chance rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Stalking Pace
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
